title.tr: Çimde lavabolu tezgâh ve üç ahşap kapaklı dolap
title.en: Counter with a sink and three timber-doored cabinets on the lawn

alt.tr: Çim alanda beyaz bloktan örülmüş, taş lavabolu tezgâh ve altında üç ahşap kapaklı dolap
alt.en: Counter built of white block with a stone sink and three timber-doored cabinets beneath, on a lawn

caption.tr: Tezgâhın altındaki kapaklar koyu vernikli ahşap ve demir menteşeli. Yapı beyaza boyanmış, önünde çim alan var.
caption.en: The doors under the counter are dark varnished timber with iron hinges. The structure is painted white with a lawn in front.
